findings.title: Keep the React message in the supported interpolation format
findings.body: This replaces the account UI's i18next placeholders (`{{0}}`, `{{1}}}`, and `{{2}}`) with Java MessageFormat syntax, including a `choice` expression. The React UI does not evaluate Java MessageFormat, so multivalued-size validation errors will display literal placeholders and the choice expression instead of the attribute name and limits. The same regression is introduced in the admin UI's English resource at line 3138. Keep the Java formatting changes confined to server-side bundles, or implement equivalent supported client-side formatting.

findings.title: Restore Lithuanian OTP setup instructions
findings.body: The replacement for `totpStep1` is Italian ('Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare'), not Lithuanian. Lithuanian users now receive OTP installation instructions in an unrelated language. The same Italian text is also introduced for `loginTotpStep1` in the Lithuanian login bundle at line 71; both should be translated into Lithuanian.
